$schema_note: Skill-owned judgement only: which scenario files a repository SHAPE needs. Triggers, called modules, permissions and inputs are NOT restated here -- follow the relevant topic links from the library's README.md at the resolved ref.

$library.note: Derived from the pipeline lifecycle and module catalog linked from the library's README.md. Those selected-ref guides are authoritative; this file follows them.

release.yml.purpose: Tag, promote candidate by digest, publish release, notify.

image-scan.yml.purpose: Scan an existing remote image tag.

chart-scan.yml.purpose: Render and scan a local or remote chart.

sbom.yml.purpose: CycloneDX SBOM generation and CVE scan.

image-only.match: Dockerfile present, no application manifest and no Chart.yaml
image-only.note: Build and scan the OCI image, but do not add license-scan.yml, sbom.yml, a language build, or SonarQube. Without an application dependency manifest those source-oriented workflows have no dependency graph to inspect. build.yml composes init + docker + the image smoke test for this shape.

chart-only.match: Chart.yaml present, no Dockerfile, no application manifest
chart-only.note: pr.yml calls init + lint + chart only -- there is nothing to compile, containerise or unit test.

library.match: application manifest, no Dockerfile, no chart, publishes a package

app-no-artifact.note: No release.yml unless the repo actually cuts releases; no image or chart scenarios.
